title: Aadhaar Card — Demographic & Mobile Number Update
verification_source: UIDAI Circular on Revision of Tariff and Official FAQs
overview: Official procedures to update demographic details (address, name, DOB, gender) and mobile number in Aadhaar records. Address can be updated online with valid proof; mobile numbers strictly require biometric authentication at an authorized centre.
eligibility: All Aadhaar holders. Address updates online require an active registered mobile number to receive OTP. If no mobile number is linked, the citizen must visit an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre / Aadhaar Seva Kendra.

fees.amount: ₹75.00 for Demographic Update | ₹125.00 for Biometric Update (Free for mandatory child updates at age 5 and 15)
fees.breakdown: ₹75 for updating address, name, DOB, or mobile number. If demographic update is combined with biometric update, only the single ₹125 fee applies.
fees.payment_mode: Online gateway on myAadhaar for online address updates; Cash/UPI/Card at authorized Aadhaar Seva Kendras.

timeline.dispatch: Update requests are typically processed within 5 to 15 working days following backend verification against official databases.
timeline.delivery: Digital e-Aadhaar is available for download immediately upon approval; updated physical PVC can be ordered separately if needed.

required_documents: For Online Address Update: Valid Proof of Address (PoA) such as Passport, Bank Passbook/Statement, Electricity Bill (not older than 3 months), Voter ID, or Registered Rent Agreement.
For Mobile Number Update: No document required; only physical presence for in-person biometric authentication at Aadhaar Seva Kendra.
steps: To Update Address Online: Visit https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in and login using your 12-digit Aadhaar number and OTP.
Enter the correct new address details matching your supporting document.
Upload a clear scanned copy or photo of the valid Proof of Address (PoA) document.
Pay the non-refundable demographic update fee of ₹75.
Save the generated Service Request Number (SRN) or Update Request Number (URN) to track status.
To Update Mobile Number: Locate nearest authorized centre via https://appointments.uidai.gov.in/easearch.aspx
Book an appointment online or walk in to the Aadhaar Seva Kendra.
Submit your request and complete biometric verification (fingerprint/iris scan). No paper documents are required for mobile update.
warnings_and_fraud_prevention: Mobile number updates CANNOT be done completely online — beware of fraudulent websites offering online phone number linking.
Ensure the scanned address proof is legitimate and clearly legible, otherwise UIDAI verifiers will reject the application without fee refund.
Do not pay more than the standard ₹75 (demographic) or ₹125 (biometric) fee at any Aadhaar centre; ask for the official UIDAI printed receipt.
checklist: Check whether your current mobile number is active to receive online OTP
Gather a valid Proof of Address (PoA) document in PDF or JPEG format
If updating mobile number, locate your nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra on appointments.uidai.gov.in
